stories.title: Define board certification measure schema and scoring contract
stories.description: Create data schema and scoring contract for provider board certification including fields for certifications, specialty mapping, relevance score, and confidence. Ensure compatibility with existing provider detail response structure.

stories.title: Implement core logic to extract and score board certifications
stories.description: Build logic to parse NPI credential/taxonomy data, identify board certifications, and compute relevance score against queried specialty using taxonomy alignment or keyword matching.

stories.title: Expose board certification score via Evaluate Care facade
stories.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include board certification measure in provider evaluation response payload, ensuring it is available to downstream consumers (chat responses/UI).

stories.title: Unit and integration tests for board certification scoring
stories.description: Create tests validating extraction of certifications from NPI data, correct specialty relevance scoring, and inclusion in API response. Include edge cases (no certifications, unrelated certifications).
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/ (existing backend test patterns for services and facades)
